hero.heading: Hi, I'm Khang
hero.bio: Software Engineer with nearly 3 years of experience designing and delivering scalable online marketplace platforms across diverse business models. Strong foundation in backend development and system design, with a focus on scalability, reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability. Currently expanding my expertise in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to build practical, production-ready AI solutions. Based in Ho Chi Minh City.

projects.heading: Projects
projects.subheading: A selection of platforms and features I've designed and shipped.

items.title: Localmingo
items.desc: A marketplace connecting travelers with local guides and unique travel experiences.

bullets.label: Off-session payments
bullets.text: Saved customer cards at checkout using Stripe SetupIntent and automatically charged them through off-session PaymentIntent upon booking confirmation. Built a post-payment Lambda workflow to transfer funds to provider Stripe Connect accounts, with DynamoDB TTL-triggered payout retries when sufficient balance becomes available.

bullets.label: Multi-currency support
bullets.text: Built a scheduled AWS Lambda to fetch exchange rates for supported currencies and cache them in DynamoDB, using async-retry for retry handling. Enabled consistent price conversion and display across frontend and backend in the user-selected currency using Decimal.js.

bullets.label: Multilingual support
bullets.text: Organized UI translations into per-module JSON files and automated translation of missing keys with an AI script. Implemented browser-language detection and locale persistence using React Context and cookies. Added dynamic AI translation for user-generated content, including listing titles/descriptions, profiles, and reviews, with translation triggered when hosts create or edit listings.

items.title: GearShare
items.desc: An AI-powered B2B marketplace for renting professional live-event equipment.

bullets.label: AI-powered semantic search
bullets.text: Built a natural-language search pipeline integrating OpenAI to generate and query vector embeddings, improving equipment discovery by matching search intent rather than relying solely on keywords.

bullets.label: Event-driven async processing
bullets.text: Designed asynchronous event processing with RabbitMQ to fan out events to independent consumers with automatic retries. Integrated AWS SQS for communication with on-demand workers to support reliable processing as event volumes grow.

bullets.label: Bidirectional inventory sync (GearSync)
bullets.text: Developed two-way inventory synchronization with self-managed API key authentication and batch processing that handles partial failures. Automated EC2 instance provisioning and termination on demand to process large datasets while optimizing operating costs.

items.title: AI-Powered Automated Grading
items.desc: An AI-powered system that automatically evaluates student submissions against expected solutions, generating scores and actionable feedback to help learners identify and correct mistakes.

items.title: Internal Knowledge Chatbot
items.desc: A retrieval-augmented (RAG) AI assistant that answers employee questions by grounding responses in internal company documents and policies.

items.title: Real vs. Fake Face Detection
items.desc: A computer vision research project using a fine-tuned ResNet-50 to classify real versus Stable Diffusion-generated face images, packaged as an interactive Streamlit app.

items.title: Document Scanner
items.desc: A lightweight OpenCV pipeline that turns raw photos into clean, high-contrast scanned documents — detecting edges, correcting perspective, and enhancing contrast automatically.
